lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Performance task: build: corrections with place-value explanations

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Set up the first two carefully; the rest of the build depends on them.

items.prompt: A charity collected $16555 in the spring and $5322 in the fall, then received an extra $2622 donation. How much money is there in total?
a concert raised 97728 dollars on Saturday and 33185 dollars on Sunday. What was the total number of dollars raised?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: a concert had 80514 visitors expected, but only 36019 attended. How many fewer people attended than expected?
A charity collected $7474 in the spring and $6816 in the fall, then received an extra $3827 donation. How much money is there in total?
a food drive raised 285735 dollars on Saturday and 482761 dollars on Sunday. What was the total number of dollars raised?
a school had 412245 visitors expected, but only 257115 attended. How many fewer people attended than expected?
A charity collected $74648 in the spring and $6398 in the fall, then received an extra $7597 donation. How much money is there in total?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Carry the build to a result and say how you would check it is right.

items.prompt: a fundraiser raised 442870 dollars on Saturday and 142963 dollars on Sunday. What was the total number of dollars raised?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: a school had 663903 visitors expected, but only 303481 attended. How many fewer people attended than expected?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
